description: This file contains unit tests for voice wake trigger sanitization, locale normalization, and related helper functions in the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: VoiceWakeHelpersTests
classes.description: A test suite for helper functions related to voice wake triggers and locale normalization.

methods.name: sanitize triggers trims and drops empty
methods.description: Tests that sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers removes whitespace-only strings and trims empty entries.

methods.name: sanitize triggers falls back to defaults
methods.description: Tests that sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers returns default triggers when input is only whitespace.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word length
methods.description: Ensures sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers enforces maximum word length.

methods.name: sanitize triggers limits word count
methods.description: Checks that sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers limits the number of words to the maximum allowed.

methods.name: normalize locale strips collation
methods.description: Verifies that normalizeLocaleIdentifier removes collation suffixes from locale identifiers.

methods.name: normalize locale strips unicode extensions
methods.description: Verifies that normalizeLocaleIdentifier removes unicode extension tags from locale identifiers.
